arch.name: Buildings/rooms
arch.short_description: Buildings, rooms, and architectural locations. Not: systems or equipment.
arch.long_description: Physical facility locations (auxiliary building, control room). Do NOT tag operational systems or equipment with this label.

ast_I_C.name: I&C
ast_I_C.short_description: Major equipment or asset names (pump, generator). Not: small parts or materials.
ast_I_C.long_description: Plant-scale equipment and assets (pump, generator, turbine, vessel). Label whole machines or assemblies, not internal fasteners or materials.

ast_eln.name: Electronic
ast_eln.short_description: Electrical/electronic component names (sensor, capacitor). Not: power asset names.
ast_eln.long_description: Small electrical/electronic parts and modules (capacitor, ADC, transistor). Do NOT use for large electrical assets (transformer, generator).

ast_elt.name: Electrical
ast_elt.short_description: Electrical/electronic component names (sensor, capacitor). Not: power asset names.
ast_elt.long_description: Small electrical/electronic parts and modules (capacitor, ADC, transistor). Do NOT use for large electrical assets (transformer, generator).

ast_fuel.name: Fuel
ast_fuel.short_description: Major equipment or asset names (pump, generator). Not: small parts or materials.
ast_fuel.long_description: Plant-scale equipment and assets (pump, generator, turbine, vessel). Label whole machines or assemblies, not internal fasteners or materials.

ast_hyd_pne.name: Hydraulic/Pneumatic
ast_hyd_pne.short_description: Hydraulic/pneumatic component names (valve, seal). Not: whole assets.
ast_hyd_pne.long_description: Small hydraulic or pneumatic parts (seal, fitting, accumulator). Avoid labeling entire devices like 'compressor' as a component.

ast_mech.name: Mechanical
ast_mech.short_description: Major equipment or asset names (pump, generator). Not: small parts or materials.
ast_mech.long_description: Plant-scale equipment and assets (pump, generator, turbine, vessel). Label whole machines or assemblies, not internal fasteners or materials.

bio_air.name: Biological air
bio_air.short_description: Terms for 'Biological air'. Not: unrelated groups.
bio_air.long_description: Terms grouped under 'Biological air'. Use this label for the intended class and not for other group types.

bio_grnd.name: Biological ground
bio_grnd.short_description: Terms for 'Biological ground'. Not: unrelated groups.
bio_grnd.long_description: Terms grouped under 'Biological ground'. Use this label for the intended class and not for other group types.

bio_insct.name: Biological insect
bio_insct.short_description: Terms for 'Biological insect'. Not: unrelated groups.
bio_insct.long_description: Terms grouped under 'Biological insect'. Use this label for the intended class and not for other group types.

bio_wtr.name: Biological water
bio_wtr.short_description: Terms for 'Biological water'. Not: unrelated groups.
bio_wtr.long_description: Terms grouped under 'Biological water'. Use this label for the intended class and not for other group types.

chem_cmpd.name: Chemical Compounds
chem_cmpd.short_description: Materials or chemical terms (alloy, steel, water). Not: equipment or events.
chem_cmpd.long_description: Material names, classes, or pure chemical terms used to describe composition (stainless steel, aluminum, water). Do NOT label tools, systems, or failure outcomes.

chem_elem.name: Chemical elements
chem_elem.short_description: Materials or chemical terms (alloy, steel, water). Not: equipment or events.
chem_elem.long_description: Material names, classes, or pure chemical terms used to describe composition (stainless steel, aluminum, water). Do NOT label tools, systems, or failure outcomes.

chem_rx.name: Chemical reaction
chem_rx.short_description: Chemical reaction names or reaction classes. Not: materials or simple chemical names.
chem_rx.long_description: Named chemical reactions or categories (acid-base, oxidation, polymerization). Use for reaction processes; do NOT use for simple compound mentions or material classes.

comp_elt_n.name: Electrical/electronic
comp_elt_n.short_description: Electrical/electronic component names (sensor, capacitor). Not: power asset names.
comp_elt_n.long_description: Small electrical/electronic parts and modules (capacitor, ADC, transistor). Do NOT use for large electrical assets (transformer, generator).

comp_hyd_pne.name: Hydraulic/Pneumatic
comp_hyd_pne.short_description: Hydraulic/pneumatic component names (valve, seal). Not: whole assets.
comp_hyd_pne.long_description: Small hydraulic or pneumatic parts (seal, fitting, accumulator). Avoid labeling entire devices like 'compressor' as a component.

comp_mech_fast.name: Fasteners
comp_mech_fast.short_description: Fastening/connecting hardware that physically joins parts or structures. Not: rotary-motion parts or structural members.
comp_mech_fast.long_description: Mechanical components designed to perform and guarantee a physical connection between components, equipment, or architectural elements (e.g., bolts, nuts, screws, anchors, pins, clamps, rivets). Not: structural/containment members themselves (beams, frames, housings) and not rotary-motion elements (shafts, bearings, gears).

comp_mech_rot.name: Elements of rotary motion drive
comp_mech_rot.short_description: Rotary-motion support components (shafts, bearings, gears). Not: structural/containment members or fasteners.
comp_mech_rot.long_description: Mechanical components designed to support, transmit, or facilitate rotary movement of other components or equipment (e.g., bearings, shafts, gears, belts, couplings). Not: structural/containment parts (frames, housings, enclosures) and not fastening/connecting hardware (bolts, nuts, rivets).

comp_mech_spec.name: Specific purpose
comp_mech_spec.short_description: Special-purpose mechanical parts for an ad‑hoc function. Not: structural/containment, rotary-motion, or fastening parts.
comp_mech_spec.long_description: Mechanical components designed to support a specific ad‑hoc function that is not primarily structural/containment, rotary-motion transmission, or fastening/connecting (e.g., filters, blades, guides, nozzles, purpose-built internals). Not: shafts/bearings/gears; not frames/housings/enclosures; not bolts/nuts/rivets.

comp_mech_struct.name: Structural
comp_mech_struct.short_description: Structural or containment mechanical parts (frames, housings, guards). Not: rotary-motion parts or fasteners.
comp_mech_struct.long_description: Mechanical components designed to support a structural or containment function (support, protection, alignment, enclosure) such as frames, guards, housings, enclosures, supports, barriers. Not: rotary-motion transmission components (shafts, bearings, gears) and not fastening/connecting hardware (bolts, rivets).

deg_mech.name: Degradation mechanism
deg_mech.short_description: Physical or chemical mechanisms that damage materials (e.g., corrosion). Not: failure outcomes or events.
deg_mech.long_description: Physical mechanisms or processes that cause material/component degradation (corrosion, erosion, fatigue). Label process terms that describe *how* damage occurs; do NOT label observable outcomes like 'leak' or 'failure'.

diagn_need.name: Diagnostic need / requirement cue
diagn_need.short_description: Cues that something diagnostic is needed or missing. Not: the diagnostic action or the failure outcome.
diagn_need.long_description: Words signaling a diagnostic need/requirement (something must be checked, information is missing, more analysis is required). Not: maintenance actions (repair/replace), not surveillance actions (inspect/check), and not failure outcomes (leak/failure).

event.name: event
event.short_description: Events and incident descriptors (accident, anomaly). Not: mechanism or component names.
event.long_description: Terms that denote incidents, transients, or events (anomaly, accident, trip). Avoid labeling mechanisms or components with this tag.

fail_type_n.name: Failure type
fail_type_n.short_description: Failure/outcome nouns (leak, rupture). Not: verbs or processes.
fail_type_n.long_description: Observable outcome nouns indicating failure or damage (leak, rupture, trip). Do NOT use when the text uses verb forms (e.g., 'leaked') or describes mechanisms.

fail_type_v.name: Failure type
fail_type_v.short_description: Failure/degradation verbs (leak, trip). Not: nominal outcomes or equipment names.
fail_type_v.long_description: Verb forms that express failure actions (leaked, failed, tripped). Do NOT label nominal failure nouns or equipment.

mat.name: Material
mat.short_description: Materials or chemical terms (alloy, steel, water). Not: equipment or events.
mat.long_description: Material names, classes, or pure chemical terms used to describe composition (stainless steel, aluminum, water). Do NOT label tools, systems, or failure outcomes.

mat_class.name: Material classes
mat_class.short_description: Materials or chemical terms (alloy, steel, water). Not: equipment or events.
mat_class.long_description: Material names, classes, or pure chemical terms used to describe composition (stainless steel, aluminum, water). Do NOT label tools, systems, or failure outcomes.

mnt_ops.name: operations
mnt_ops.short_description: Maintenance-operation verbs that change equipment state. Not: surveillance checks or health ratings.
mnt_ops.long_description: Verbs indicating maintenance operations designed to update, modify, repair, or restore the performance or physical configuration of equipment/assets/components. Not: surveillance/monitoring verbs (check, observe) and not qualitative health ratings (high/low/normal).

mnt_tool.name: maintenance tools
mnt_tool.short_description: Tools, instruments, or inspection methods. Not: the activity verb or object.
mnt_tool.long_description: Names of tools and NDT methods (ultrasonic testing, torque wrench). Do NOT confuse tool/method names with actions or objects they operate on.

opd_elt.name: Electrical
opd_elt.short_description: Electrical/electronic component names (sensor, capacitor). Not: power asset names.
opd_elt.long_description: Small electrical/electronic parts and modules (capacitor, ADC, transistor). Do NOT use for large electrical assets (transformer, generator).

opd_hyd_pne.name: Hydraulic/Pneumatic
opd_hyd_pne.short_description: Hydraulic/pneumatic component names (valve, seal). Not: whole assets.
opd_hyd_pne.long_description: Small hydraulic or pneumatic parts (seal, fitting, accumulator). Avoid labeling entire devices like 'compressor' as a component.

plant.name: nuclear plants
plant.short_description: Reactor or plant type (PWR, BWR). Not: equipment or materials.
plant.long_description: Names and abbreviations for reactor types or plant classes (PWR, BWR). Do NOT apply to components or substances.

prop.name: Properties
prop.short_description: Measured properties or operands (temperature, pressure). Not: parts or events.
prop.long_description: Quantities or properties that are measured or described (pressure, voltage, dose rate). Do NOT label instruments or failures.

qual_asmnt.name: qualitative assessment
qual_asmnt.short_description: Qualitative health/status ratings. Not: numeric measurements or action verbs.
qual_asmnt.long_description: Qualitative (not quantitative) assessment of the performance or physical status (health) of a system/equipment/asset/component. Use for categorical levels such as high/low/normal. Not: measured quantities (pressure, voltage) and not action verbs (inspect, repair).

states_matter.name: States of matter
states_matter.short_description: Materials or chemical terms (alloy, steel, water). Not: equipment or events.
states_matter.long_description: Material names, classes, or pure chemical terms used to describe composition (stainless steel, aluminum, water). Do NOT label tools, systems, or failure outcomes.

surv_ops_n.name: surveillance ops
surv_ops_n.short_description: Action verbs or assessment terms (inspect, replace, high). Not: equipment nouns.
surv_ops_n.long_description: Operational or maintenance action verbs and qualitative assessment terms used to describe activities or levels. Label verbs and adjectives; avoid tagging equipment nouns.

surv_ops_v.name: surveillance ops
surv_ops_v.short_description: Surveillance/monitoring verbs that check health/status. Not: repair/modify actions or ratings.
surv_ops_v.long_description: Verbs indicating surveillance operations where the performance or physical status (health) of a system/equipment/asset/component is monitored, verified, tested, or checked. Not: maintenance verbs that modify/restore (repair, replace) and not qualitative assessments (high/low).

surv_tool.name: surveillance_tools
surv_tool.short_description: Tools, instruments, or inspection methods. Not: the activity verb or object.
surv_tool.long_description: Names of tools and NDT methods (ultrasonic testing, torque wrench). Do NOT confuse tool/method names with actions or objects they operate on.

syst.name: Systems
syst.short_description: System names and functional groups (AFW, CVCS). Not: components or rooms.
syst.long_description: Names or acronyms of operational systems and their full names (e.g., Auxiliary Feedwater System). Avoid tagging single parts or locations.
